name: labeldepth-p2-s2
description: DRAFT SECOND SEED (coordinator 11-13 08:36): ply-2-trained fields carry per-line run SD ~28 and the levers seeds split by 57-73 at ply 2, so the depth-3 rule needs two seeds; launched while the machine idles (load ~4 of 8 cores); read pooled with labeldepth-p2-s1 (batch7-reads/labeldepth2b-read.sh). Otherwise identical. LABEL DEPTH ABOVE THE PLAY at ply 2 (coordinator 11-13 07:11; the analyst out of credits). labeldepth-p1 (two seeds, windows) found the deeper label's value rising with the read ply (d2 - d1 = -17 / +59 / +74 at plies 1 / 2 / 3; d1 - p +68 / -4 / -36; d2 - p +50 / +55 / +38): a label as deep as the play helps only at that ply, a deeper one helps at every ply read. Here: one ply-2 field, three F-P lines on the same games: result labels (p), depth-2 labels (d2 = play depth; a third seed of levers-p2's line), depth-3 labels (d3 = play + 1). Measured label cost: depth 3 57 CPU-s a cycle (136k positions) vs depth 2 6.5; the field ~9.5 CPU-h to cap 401. Reads with version windows vs y/v/l @299 at plies 2 and 3 (and 4 at the final). PREDICTION: d3 - p 30-60 at ply 2 and 40-80 at ply 3 at the final; d3 - d2 positive and larger at ply 3. RULE: d3 - p 30+ at plies 2 and 3 (windows) => the ply-2 rung's flats train on depth-3 labels (+6 CPU-h a run); d3 within 15 of p => label depth is not the lever at ply 2.
